P'Tui (พี่ทุย), young adult male Thai water buffalo, anthropomorphic 3D Pixar-style character, standing upright on two legs. Dark charcoal-grey, almost black, short fur all over, with a shaggy messy tuft of darker fur on top of his head between the horns. Large wide horns curving outward and up, grey-brown with ridged texture and darker tips. Ears stick out sideways, pale pink inside. Broad grey muzzle with large nostrils, rosy pink blush on both cheeks, big round warm brown eyes, eyebrows raised in the middle giving a worried, apologetic look, mouth in a small sad frown. Thin tan rope cord worn around his neck. Loose long-sleeved indigo-blue textured cotton Thai shirt (seua mor hom style) with a short stand collar, four brown knotted frog-toggle fastenings down the center front, and two large patch pockets at the lower front. Rust-red plaid pha khao ma cloth sash tied around the waist with a knot at the front and two long fringed ends hanging down. Dark brown-grey baggy Thai farmer trousers, gathered just below the knee, showing furry lower legs. Bare dark cloven hooves, no shoes. A large round woven bamboo/rattan hat slung flat on his back behind his shoulders. Default pose: standing straight, facing forward, both hands tucked behind his back, shy and guilty expression. Keep exactly the same face, horns, fur colour, outfit and accessories as the reference image in every clip.
